bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to local government; permitting an owner to rent or lease a portion of the owner's homestead property; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 462.357, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 1j.

Homestead rentals.

(a) For the purposes of this subdivision, "homestead" has the meaning provided in section 273.124, subdivision 1.

(b) A municipality must not prohibit an owner from renting or leasing a portion of the owner's homestead property as a dwelling if:

(1) the homestead is a single family home; and

(2) the owner resides on the homestead property as the owner's primary dwelling.

(c) Rental of a portion of a homestead property pursuant to paragraph (b) is a permitted single family use for the purposes of zoning.

(d) Paragraph (b) does not prohibit a municipality from enforcing other laws, rules, regulations, and ordinances relating to residential rental properties, including landlord-tenant law.
additions: (a) For the purposes of this subdivision, "homestead" has the meaning provided in section 273.124, subdivision 1.

(2) the owner resides on the homestead property as the owner's primary dwelling.
(c) Rental of a portion of a homestead property pursuant to paragraph (b) is a permitted single family use for the purposes of zoning.
(d) Paragraph (b) does not prohibit a municipality from enforcing other laws, rules, regulations, and ordinances relating to residential rental properties, including landlord-tenant law.
